title: Chapter 1458 - 7: The Terrifying Lin Yuan

Chapter 1458 - 7: The Terrifying Lin Yuan

Chapter 1458 - 7: The Terrifying Lin Yuan

If given a choice, Lord Zhuo He would prefer not to conflict with Lin Yuan.

But this is a struggle for transcendence, involving hope for transcendence.

It's not just about Lin Yuan, even entities like Fantian Lord, Lord Haotian, who have survived over three hundred million calamities.

Lord Zhuo He dares to take action and fight.

"Hmm?"

"Lord Zhuo He, do you intend to strike at me?"

Lin Yuan also sensed Lord Zhuo He's killing intent, stopped his climbing, and observed his opponent.

For Lin Yuan, this scene was anticipated and not surprising.

With his climbing speed, he was destined to catch up with the leading Legendary Lords ahead.

Most Legendary Lords might refrain from acting, as having one more or less Lin Yuan doesn't enhance their hope for transcendence.

But a few Legendary Lords, especially those ranked among the front

ones.

Will absolutely not willingly give up the chance for transcendence. "Galaxy Lord, if you switch to another jade staircase, consider it a favor from me, treasure? Rare finds are at your request, as long as I can provide them."

Lord Zhuo He said earnestly: "But if you insist on continuing to climb this jade staircase, don't blame me for fighting desperately."

Lord Zhuo He fixed his gaze on Lin Yuan as he spoke.

"Switch to another jade staircase?"

Lin Yuan chuckled, "Why not directly ask me to give up this path of transcendence?"

Thirty-three thousand three hundred and thirty-three jade staircases scattered across endless dimensions, global Legendary Lords climbed in succession, obtaining various intelligence about the jade staircases. One point is that a lord can only climb one jade staircase at a time.

In other words, if Lin Yuan withdrew from climbing this jade staircase and chose another, he'd have to start from scratch.

A slow step, slow every step.

Originally, Lin Yuan was already slightly behind the first batch of Legendary Lords.

Choosing a new jade staircase?

Even though Lin Yuan's climbing speed could still catch up with the Legendary Lords ahead, starting over wasn't necessary.

Isn't it possible that the other jade staircases have no Legendary Lords?

Involving hope for transcendence, those Legendary Lords would surely make choices akin to Lord Zhuo He's.

Would still strike against Lin Yuan.

"In that case."

Lord Zhuo He's figure suddenly exploded, transforming into a vast and mighty turbid river.

Lord Zhuo He's true form is an immense turbid river of endless dimensional realms, born 'spirit' at the limit of Second Layer, capable of challenging true time-life forms.

In terms of foundational mass, Lord Zhuo He is hundreds and thousands of times that of other beings at the same tier.

"Galaxy Lord, let me see if your reputation matches your strength."

Lord Zhuo He's voice reverberated within the vast turbid river, its terrifying aura pressing against all archaic paths and time.

"That's..."

"Lord Zhuo He has made his move."

"Indeed, Galaxy Lord's climbing speed is too fast, sooner or later, destined to collide with Lord Zhuo He."

"Hahaha, it's uncertain if the Galaxy Lord can continue to climb."

From below the jade staircase, many Legendary Lords noticed the change and stared from a distance at Lin Yuan and Lord Zhuo He's position.

These Legendary Lords held not great hope for transcendence, but seeing Galaxy Lord and Lord Zhuo He clash, they became intrigued.

Lin Yuan ascended step by step, with each Legendary Lord below lowering their heads in deference, now eager to witness Lin Yuan's true strength.

"Fight, fight."

"The more time you waste, the greater the gap I'll be able to widen."

Above the jade staircases, a shadow of dark aura glanced below, not lingering to watch but continuing to climb.

That was the Dark Star Lord, no weaker than Lord Zhuo He, possibly

even stronger.

Originally, the Dark Star Lord led Lord Zhuo He by a margin but still

felt unsure.

No assurance of remaining in the lead.

But now.

Lord Zhuo He, who was closely behind him, clashed with the Galaxy

Lord, aligning with the Dark Star Lord's interests.

Whether it was the Galaxy Lord or Lord Zhuo He, both were

extremely strong.

For such beings to determine victory? It can't be done quickly.

"What an intriguing life form?"

Lin Yuan observed the vast turbid river and nodded slightly, "It's said that within the turbid river, all causalities are isolated and suppressed;

today, I see it for myself."

"Galaxy Lord, you still have a chance to turn back now."

Lord Zhuo He's voice echoed continuously.

"No need."

Lin Yuan shook his head, while raising his right hand, Tai Yi, Tai Chu,

Tai Shi, Tai Su, the four "Tai' forces intertwined and collided.

"Suppress."

Seeing this, Lord Zhuo He, without hesitation, unleashed the mighty force of the turbid river, crushing towards Lin Yuan.

Since Lin Yuan was unwilling to retreat, Lord Zhuo He naturally wouldn't hold back; suppressing Lin Yuan swiftly and catching up or even surpassing the Dark Star Lord was what mattered.

Buzzing~ The four "Tai' forces intertwined at Lin Yuan's fingertips, rapidly expanding outward.

Wherever the 'Tai' forces passed, everything perished, matter,

non-matter, rules, cosmic paths, everything, succumbed to the

inevitable eradication.

Except for the eternal jade staircase, everything perished quickly, including the mighty turbid river force.

"This is" Lord Zhuo He, once assured of his victory, underwent a dramatic change in expression, in mere moments, sensing his true hody the turbid river had been over seventy nercent annihilated The river, refined to its utmost, one drop can suppress ordinary lords, but under the four Tai' forces, it had no resistance whatsoever. "Galaxy Lord, cease immediately, I am willing to let you ascend! I am willing to let you ascend!"
